quote: Seventeen detectors run, one model per entity, and a silent host scores zero.
problem: Zero imputation makes the counted value zero, not the anomaly grade, and only the volume detectors set it, so the sentence says silence is graded as normal when the design exists to make silence visible.

fix: Write: "Seventeen detectors run, one model per entity, and a volume detector reads a silent host as zero records, so silence is a value it can grade."

quote: Three lanes read those numbers.
problem: The antecedent is the pushed heartbeats and the poller's cluster samples, but fourteen of the seventeen detectors read the three log families and the nine trend rules read rows rolled up from the logs, so detection reads more than platform health.
source: reports/inputs/dataflow-atlas.md:196 (fourteen log detectors read the three log families, three read cockpit-metrics); reports/loggy-report/briefs/walkthroughs-3-5.md:141
fix: Write: "Three lanes read numbers: the health samples above, and the counts, error rates and lags rolled up from the logs themselves."

quote: It never queries the cluster, so it holds when the cluster is down.
problem: "It" reads as the shifter view, which walkthrough 1 step 7 has querying the central index, so the reader cannot tell which claim holds.

fix: "Its live page never queries the cluster, so the page holds when the cluster is down. A second lane in the same page does search the central index, capped at 20,000 rows."
